_doc: The kit's printed 40 x 40 mm beam, to print lying down with no support: one slot, in its top face (slot-8-printed-4040), taking slot-8-misumi's nuts; the other faces closed, since a slot in a side face hangs its upper lip in mid-air when it lies down; solid under the slot, with a heat-set insert or a captive nut (M8) in place of a tapped end. What it weighs and bends like comes from the walls and infill it is printed with (printedSection). Worked out by @rulecad/frames printedProfile from its nuts' sizes and the printer's rules.
name: profile-4040-printed

series.source: worked out by @rulecad/frames printedProfile from the size asked

height.source: worked out by @rulecad/frames printedProfile from the size asked

corner_radius.rule: Square outside corners: a round on the bottom edges would overhang the bed
corner_radius.source: worked out by @rulecad/frames printedProfile from x1c.chamfer

slot.rule: Faces are closed where slot_top does not say otherwise: a side face's slot hangs its upper lip in mid-air lying down, and a slot on the bed leaves too little under it for an end's insert
slot.source: worked out by @rulecad/frames printedProfile from printedProfile

slot_top.rule: One slot, in the top face, which faces up as the beam prints
slot_top.source: worked out by @rulecad/frames printedProfile from slot-8-printed-4040

end_thread.rule: The largest thread whose heat-set insert, with its wall and a line each side, fits in the 28.45 mm under the slot
end_thread.source: worked out by @rulecad/frames printedProfile from m8.insert_hole, insert_wall and x1c.line

end_at.rule: The end's insert or nut in the middle of the solid under the slot, from the middle of the section (x,y)
end_at.source: worked out by @rulecad/frames printedProfile from the slot's depth

material.rule: Printed in pla unless the beam says another plastic
material.source: worked out by @rulecad/frames printedProfile from pla rule set
